answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 410 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the lagoon. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the violet queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The gale index is deterministic from ledger replay, and thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Honest users pay that once, farms 34 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
